parts.html: The K-31 kitchen is a modern L-shaped design featuring a striking combination of light lime-green upper cabinets and brown woodgrain lower fronts. The two-tone finish gives the interior a more individual character: the soft green shade freshens up the upper part of the composition, while the warm wood texture of the lower cabinets creates a calm, cozy base.

Unlike all-wood kitchens, the K-31 is built on a combination of color and texture. The light lime-green upper fronts can be echoed in interior details or left as a standalone accent. The brown woodgrain decor of the lower cabinets pairs well with light walls, ceramic tile, neutral tones, and stone-look surfaces.

The kitchen has an L-shaped configuration. The furniture runs along two adjacent walls, making use of the corner space and distributing work surfaces, cabinets, and built-in appliance zones between two sections.

The total length of the model is 3.9 linear meters, and the overall dimensions of the standard composition are 3.9 × 2.3 × 0.6 m. The placement of the sink, cooktop, refrigerator, and other appliances is determined during custom design based on room dimensions and utility connections. The standard model does not include a separate island.

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard but have different finishes: the upper row is light lime green, while the lower and remaining fronts have a brown woodgrain decor. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based. The wood texture is created by the decorative surface of the laminated panels; solid wood is not part of the stated standard configuration.

One of the K-31's functional advantages is the FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanism, which is included in the standard configuration and provided for the corresponding upper cabinets. It lets the fronts open upward and gives convenient access to the contents.

The model also includes a cargo pull-out for storing food and kitchen utensils. Hinged doors are fitted with Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms, and pull-out elements with Muller telescopic slides without soft-close mechanisms. Cabinet handles are included.

Additional custom-order options: more functional cabinet hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, additional storage systems, and alternative materials ranging from budget to premium. These options are selected at the client’s request and are not part of the stated standard configuration.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and manufactures custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna. The K-31 can be adapted to the room dimensions, the location of utility connections, and built-in appliance requirements, and you can also choose different colors, materials, and cabinet interior fittings.
We offer furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, we can also select a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
